mapper.select: SELECT bf.block_id FROM block_file bf WHERE bf.file_id = #{fileId} LIMIT 1

SELECT file_version_id AS fileVersionId, version_no AS versionNo, original_file_name AS originalFileName, extension AS extension, size_bytes AS sizeBytes, page_count AS pageCount, comment AS comment, uploader_name AS uploaderName, uploader_department AS uploaderDepartment, uploader_position AS uploaderPosition, completed_at AS completedAt FROM file_version WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND upload_status = 'COMPLETED' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY version_no DESC

SELECT f.file_id AS fileId, f.name AS name, lv.file_version_id AS latestVersionId, lv.version_no AS latestVersionNo, vc.cnt AS versionCount, lv.original_file_name AS originalFileName, lv.extension AS extension, lv.size_bytes AS sizeBytes, lv.uploader_name AS uploaderName, lv.uploader_department AS uploaderDepartment, lv.uploader_position AS uploaderPosition, lv.completed_at AS updatedAt, f.deleted_at AS deletedAt FROM block_file bf JOIN file f ON f.file_id = bf.file_id JOIN ( SELECT fv.file_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt, MAX(fv.version_no) AS mx FROM file_version fv WHERE fv.upload_status = 'COMPLETED' AND fv.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY fv.file_id ) vc ON vc.file_id = f.file_id JOIN file_version lv ON lv.file_id = f.file_id AND lv.version_no = vc.mx AND lv.upload_status = 'COMPLETED' AND lv.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE bf.block_id = #{blockId} AND ( (#{deleted} = FALSE AND f.deleted_at IS NULL) OR (#{deleted} = TRUE AND f.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) ) ORDER BY bf.linked_at ASC
